notes.title: Untold Tales Presents - Summer Game-Fiesta
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/f7c3eb79e1661724e66c0254bbe68cc030f8ff1d.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings, fellow gamers![/h3]
[b]Before we all go full summer mode chilling out on the beach this is the time when we can enjoy the summertime-gaming-fiesta filled with releases, sales and new surprises straight from the Untold Tales world![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/392ee1f0d8546543f4f64db832bb689e5d9ce084.png[/img]
[h3]Since our last episode of Untold Tales Presents, we’ve released the following gaming goodies:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374230/Flame_Keeper

The moment you've all been waiting for is finally here! Flame Keeper is blazing out of early access and into full release with version 1.0! Get ready to ignite your gaming spirit as we introduce the Prophet, a wise villager who's seen more than a few winters and will guide you through the new Cloud biome, where you'll find icy islands that make winter wonderlands look like beach vacations. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225610/Ready_Steady_Ship/

Experience conveyor belt mayhem like never before, tackle the challenges of the factory floor, from operating and fixing malfunctioning machinery to navigating treacherous obstacles and prepare for the upcoming Let’s Party Update, which brings seven new minigames to the factory on June 28th.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227650/BangOn_Balls_Chronicles/

The Wild West Map has just hit town, and it's a real humdinger! We're talking 5 diverse regions to explore, each with its unique flavor. From the dusty saloons to the treacherous oil fields, there's somethin' for everyone!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/be94a1e819b9e098761440ca12ca3a7a29d59f97.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473640/EcoGnomix/

[h3]Channel your inner Gnome and get ready for EcoGnomix! [/h3]
Build a covert business empire, by looting the underground world with a team of gnomes, combine upgrades strategically to help your gnomes survive an unlimited supply of mystical caves with unique flora and fauna. The future of our gnomes is in your hands!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/cb333a10276e81714b48cf6c1e7fbaf5d0adfe12.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=VuIPqL-GCeU;full][/previewyoutube][h3]The sun-soaked shores of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/untoldtales/sale/untoldtales2024]Untold Tales Publisher Sale[/url] await you![/h3]
Explore diverse worlds, engage in captivating stories, and experience unforgettable gameplay.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42192/Untold_Tales_Treasures__30_for_30/
[h3]On top of that, we’ve launched the Untold Tales Treasures - a special gaming bundle filled with our titles, each designed with one ultimate goal: to deliver a unique gaming experience that will leave a lasting impression.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/e6138e06f05a18fb75e4e89bfe8fbcde94ba4454.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/bff53bbb136d69eebfd0dcaf1119dc020882e85c.png[/img]
[h3]There never was a better chance to show off your balls to your friends![/h3]
Thanks to our collaboration with GimmeSwag we created the Ultimate Bang-On Balls: Chronicles plushie coming at you straight from the Roman Army. 
[b]Secure your Roman Army plushie today at [url=https://www.gimmeswag.com/products/bang-on-balls-plush?utm_source=In-Game&utm_medium=Pop+Up&utm_campaign=BoB+Roman+Army+Plush]GimmeSwag Store[/url]![/b]

Put on your headphones just like you would a radio helmet, and get ready to immerse yourself in the world of The Cub with all episodes of Radio Nostalgia Broadcast.

notes.title: Tools Up! Garden Party Episode 3 is Ripe for the Picking and Episode 1 is Free!
notes.content:
The leaves are changing color, pumpkins are getting plump, and there’s a nip in the air—it must be fall! Bundle up in your favorite sweater and get ready for harvest time in the garden in [i]Tools Up Garden Party’s[/i] final chapter, [i]Episode 3: Home Sweet Home[/i]. If you get the latest episode before [b]September 1[/b], [b]you’ll save 10%[/b]*!

[h3]Watch the release trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=czyyb41WC90;full][/previewyoutube]

Ahh, how can you not fall in love with the fiery reds and golds of fall leaves? They really transform the garden...into a big mess! Raking leaves and picking hardy fall vegetables are just some of the new mechanics waiting for you to discover this final fall episode along with [b]15 all-new autumn levels[/b]. You’ll have to focus really hard to get the job done this time (we know how hard it can be to resist jumping into your tidy piles of leaves!).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415450/Tools_Up_Garden_Party__Episode_3_Home_Sweet_Home/


Besides the temptation of crunchy leaf piles, [i]Episode 3[/i] has something else that’s set on keeping you from finishing in time—[b]the Stinky Smog[/b]! The latest challenger you’ll have to face will keep you on your toes (or should we say with your fingers on your nose?) whipping past at any time to steal things you need or mess up your piles of leaves. Luckily Tools Up Co.’s faithful pup can help you keep the troublemaker away.

[h3]Get Episode 1 for free and save big on everything Tools Up![/h3]

[i]Episode 1[/i] for free?? That’s right! We had to celebrate this special occasion in a big way, so [b]starting from 5pm CEST on September 25[/b], anyone who owns the base game, [i]Tools Up![/i], can get [i]Episode 1: The Tree House[/i] for free here [b]on Steam for 48hrs (till 5pm CEST August 27)[/b]! This is the perfect opportunity to try out the [i]Garden Party DLC[/i] if you already love [i]Tools Up![/i] but you’re not sure if you want to take the party outside (we promise you, it’s awesome in the garden!).

Besides the [b]48hr giveaway[/b] and launch discount, we’ve got a lot of other great promos lined up for you:

[list]
[*] 🛠️ Want to get in on some good ol’ classic home renovations? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1004490/Tools_Up/]Tools Up![/url] is [b]70% off[/b]! 

[*] 🌱🌞 Want to get out and into the garden for some seasonal fun instead? We got you—the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408620/Tools_Up_Garden_Party__Season_Pass/]Tools Up! Garden Party Season Pass[/url] (which includes all 3 episodes) is [b]25% off[/b]! 

[*]🌱🌞🍁 Not sure if you want all 3 episodes yet? Not a problem. Separate episodes* (1 & 2) are [b]35% off each[/b]! 

[*] 🛠️🌱🌞🍁 Want EVERYTHING?! Get a bundle of [i]Tools Up![/i] and the [i]Garden Party DLC[/i] [b]20% off[/b]!
[/list]

All of these great sales last until [b]September 15[/b].

So what are you waiting for? Fall 🍁 into Episode 3: Home Sweet Home now and see if you can find out where the Stinky Smog came from as you finish Tools Up Co.’s renovation job at the Tree House at last!

*[b]If buying Episodes separately, remember: [/b]
[list]
[*] To play Ep. 2, you must first get Ep. 1.
[*] To play Ep. 3, you must first get Eps. 1 + 2.
[/list]

notes.title: Tools Up! is Throwing a Garden Party of DLC!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35018434/636b2276207aa616c32d834898cc7adc193ef286.png[/img]

The moment you’ve all been waiting for is here—it’s finally spring! Wait...that wasn’t the big news… Oh, right! Spring has finally arrived in [i]Tools Up[/i]! and the crew is back with the first-ever DLC, [i]Tools Up! Garden Party[/i]! Gather your friends for local co-op or play it yourself, but hop to it because these gardens need your help!

[h2]Watch the Tools Up! Garden Party Trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=02y8kZw7d6E;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Tools Up! Garden Party[/i] features tons of new mechanics, tools, and exciting levels waiting to be discovered through three separate seasonal episodes. [i]Episode 1: The Tree House[/i] is available to play now while Episodes 2 and 3 will be available soon! Each episode will also feature a challenging opponent. In the first episode, keep a look out for a trickster raccoon—you’ll have to beat more than just the clock now! 

[h2]Check out the Release Roadmap[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35018434/3f78a746aa1127912eff5b7cc1c06c507411bd03.jpg[/img]

All [i]Garden Party[/i] episodes can be purchased together in the Season Pass for $14.99, or separately for $5.99. However, please note that to play Episodes 2 and 3 you must also have completed the previous episodes. Get your garden party started today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415430/Tools_Up_Garden_Party__Episode_1_The_Tree_House/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408620/Tools_Up_Garden_Party__Season_Pass/

To make this occasion even more special, [i]Tools Up![/i] is on sale! If you haven’t already, [b]you can get the game 75% off when you get it before April 28[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1004490/Tools_Up/

[h2]The Tools Up! Garden Party Story[/h2]

The Tools Up! Co. crew were coming back from another successful renovation, when suddenly something fell on the road in front of them! They got out of the car and saw an enormous tree house surrounded by broken branches. It was practically falling apart before their eyes—this was going to take some work! It’s a good thing Tools Up! Co. was in the right place at the right time. Only they have the skills to restore order to this place!

[h2]What’s waiting for you in Episode 1?[/h2]

We don’t want to spoil all the surprises, but here’s a sneak peek at some of the features waiting for you in the tree house.

Growing plants need lots of care and watering. One of the fastest ways to get the job done is to use a garden hose, but will you be able to control its attempts to escape? It’s best to do this job with a friend to help you regulate the water’s flow, but if you go it alone you’d better hold on tight—thar she blows!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f8USGhU.gif[/img]

A few artistic statues perfectly complement the look of any garden. Find your inner Michelangelo and make some statues yourself! If this sounds like the thing for you, then you’ll be pleased to find out that statues won’t be the only decorative items you'll be able to make in the game. notes.title: New update released! - 4-player split keyboard, new mode, and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35018434/19554b5e78a8a3ecdd54c70a61f2e78a8d46a97c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dear Renovators![/h3]We have some great news for you. The much-requested [b]4-players split keyboard[/b] has been added to the game. And for those of you who are not fond of time pressure when designing apartments, we have implemented the [b]No Time Limit Mode[/b]!

A bunch of meaningful fixes and improvements has also been implemented based on your suggestions and reports. Your continued support is greatly appreciated. Don’t stop being awesome!

[h2]4-player Split Keyboard Support[/h2]Thanks to this new control method, you can now play locally with up to three other players on a single keyboard! You can also attach another keyboard to make it more comfortable (recommended, unless you all have really small hands). You can enable the Split Keyboards Support in the Settings Menu.
Dibbs on WASD!

[b]Note:[/b] Due to hardware limitations, it might be impossible for some keyboards to maintain the number of inputs required for 4 players on a single keyboard.

This method works for Steam Remote Play Together as well. You can play with other players who own keyboards. How cool is that!

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/CPUcUZc]Discord server[/url] and find other people willing to play online!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35018434/44fd48933233ba6a43f30d4ff6096627c8edb62c.png[/img]

[h2]No Time Limit Mode[/h2]An alternative campaign mode in which you collect points for stars without time pressure. To finish the level you must either complete all tasks and clean up, or quit the level from the pause menu. You can select this mode when starting a new campaign.

Take your time and create stunning interiors while waiting for the delivery man who’s always late.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35018434/fbaa5fcf3316a1de8616c0c3bf46f8e66d1a3da1.png[/img]

[h2]List of changes[/h2]
[h3]⭐ Features:[/h3][list][*] Added 4-player Split Keyboard Support (described above)
[*] Added a new game mode: No Time Limit Mode (described above)[/list]
[h3]⚙ Updates:[/h3][list][*] New wall building method—you no longer need to perform the object targeting action. From now on, just press the action button and the character will automatically place the first layer of the wall in the direction in which he or she (or it!) is facing.
[*] Improved tutorial tooltips when actions are performed out of order.
[*] Added a caption after completing a blueprint task
[*] Players no longer lose stars in the Party Mode if they achieve a lower score than before
[*] The delivery man now delivers materials after you tear down a wall, even if it’s not the required wall
[*] Unified Win and Fail score screens[/list]
[h3]🔧 Fixes:[/h3][list][*] Players can now correctly scoop from a fallen container (bucket or paint) but they cannot put the item back unless the container has been picked up
[*] If there’s a spot under furniture, a player who’s approaching the furniture won’t slip over the spot
[*] Characters who step on spilled paint while carrying furniture now return to a neutral animation correctly
[*] Reduced the number of cases when it’s possible to put blueprints inside a wall
[*] Trash and materials can now be put back with the Pick Up / Put Down action rather than the Apply action
[*] It is no longer possible to block input by choosing characters and levels in the Party Mode
[*] Fixed an issue with registering points incorrectly on the level with two blueprints
[*] When climbing down a ladder to the water, players will no longer be blocked by passing objects
[*] Fixed misleading blueprint instructions on level 10
[*] Fixed various level 25 issues
[*] Fixed an issue with overlapping textures on level 9
[*] Fixed an issue with blocking a character’s input on level 26 upon falling off the bridge after slipping
[*] Fixed an issue whereby a character who was carried by another player would be teleported back upon falling off the bridge on level 26 instead of being delivered by a delivery man
[*] Fixed an issue with a water field which was treated as an apartment field on level 6
[*] Fixed a visual issue of trash and paint spots on lava
[*] Fixed various UI issues in the Options and Controls menus[/list]

If you like the changes,[b] please consider dropping us a review on Steam[/b] so we can continue to grow!

As always, if you have any ideas or suggestions, don’t hesitate to let us know. We look forward to hearing from you on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1004490/discussions/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/CPUcUZc]Discord[/url]. Also, we don’t bite!

tags.feature: Added 4-player Split Keyboard Support (described above)
Added a new game mode: No Time Limit Mode (described above)

New wall building method—you no longer need to perform the object targeting action. From now on, just press the action button and the character will automatically place the first layer of the wall in the direction in which he or she (or it!) is facing.
Improved tutorial tooltips when actions are performed out of order.
Added a caption after completing a blueprint task

Unified Win and Fail score screens

notes.title: The first update is available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35018434/30fa8a85a0595e0f176b61e849c7cb3aa6480e88.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dear Renovators![/h3]Firstly, thank you for the fantastic reception of Tools Up! Now, we’re using your feedback to make it even better! 

For the past few days we’ve been gathering your suggestions and have rolled up our sleeves to put some of the ideas to work.

[b]Here’s what’s new:[/b][list][*] Improved object targeting priorities
[*] Added new tutorial boards before the beginning of levels
[*] Decreased action controls input lag
[*] Changed the order of tooltips on the first level, to emphasize that it’s possible to rotate the camera without opening the blueprint
[*] Paint spills can no longer occur on the first level
[*] Throwing items is now easier
[*] Blocked possibility to throw objects near the dumpster to prevent them from getting stuck on a wall[/list]
If you’re happy about the changes, please consider dropping us a review on Steam!

Now, we gotta go - there’s more work that needs to be done. You can expect more news from us next week. In the meantime, please don’t stop sharing your fantastic suggestions and ideas with us!

[b]Have fun![/b]
